$comment: Test fixtures for APW-11 T8 (apps/api/src/app-launcher/platform-catalog.service.spec.ts). Each case is self-contained so the spec can feed one at a time and assert its outcome; the file is deliberately NOT a valid catalog — several cases must fail validation, which is the point. The two paths that need real bytes (`icons/oversize.svg`, `icons/script.svg`) are written by the spec at test time (see `generatedIcons`), so no 16 KB blob is committed.

generatedIcons.icons/oversize.svg: Buffer.alloc(16385, 'x') wrapped in a minimal <svg> element — one byte over APP_LAUNCHER_ICON_MAX_BYTES (16,384).
generatedIcons.icons/script.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><script>alert(1)</script></svg> — refused by the SVG deny patterns.
generatedIcons.icons/foreign-object.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><foreignObject/></svg> — refused by the SVG deny patterns.

cases.name: missingDevelopUrl
cases.expect: listed for production and stage, absent for develop

entry.name: Ever No Develop
entry.description: Has no develop address, so develop never shows it (FR-10).

cases.name: javascriptUrl
cases.expect: dropped with reason unsafeUrl — produces no tile (ACC-11-08)

cases.name: httpUrl
cases.expect: dropped with reason unsafeUrl — produces no tile (ACC-11-08)

entry.name: Ever Http
entry.description: Address is plain http, which is never opened outside a local installation.

cases.name: userinfoUrl
cases.expect: dropped — an address carrying userinfo is refused by toSafeLauncherUrl (plan §4.6)

entry.name: Ever Userinfo
entry.description: Address carries credentials in the authority.

cases.name: oversizeIcon
cases.expect: entry KEPT without an icon (initials tile) — a bad icon never removes a platform (plan §9.2)

entry.name: Ever Oversize Icon
entry.description: Its icon is one byte over the cap.

cases.name: scriptIcon
cases.expect: entry KEPT without an icon — the SVG deny pattern rejects the file, not the platform

entry.name: Ever Script Icon
entry.description: Its icon contains a script element.

cases.name: badIconPath
cases.expect: dropped — the icon path must match ^icons/[a-z0-9-]+\.(svg|png)$

entry.name: Ever Bad Icon Path
entry.description: Its icon path points outside icons/.

cases.name: unknownStatus
cases.expect: dropped (FR-11 drops entries with an unknown status)

entry.name: Ever Unknown Status
entry.description: Status is not in the enum.

cases.name: descriptionTooLong
cases.expect: dropped — the description is capped at 80 characters

entry.name: Ever Long Description
entry.description: This description is deliberately longer than the eighty character cap that APW-11 FR-9 and plan section five point two both set for a catalog entry, so validation drops it.

cases.name: duplicateId
cases.expect: the second entry is dropped, and CI refuses the file (unique ids are a workflow check, not a schema one) — pins are keyed by `platform:<id>`, so a duplicate would merge two platforms into one preference row

entry.name: Ever Example Duplicate
entry.description: Repeats the id of the first case.

cases.name: twentyFifthEntry
cases.expect: dropped — the catalog is capped at 24 entries (FR-11, ACC-11-08). The spec builds it by repeating the first valid entry under 25 distinct ids rather than committing 25 objects here.
